Posted by Darlene League on Feb 3rd, 2019 // No Comments
Patriot Wealth Management Inc. lowered its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 17.2% in the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 120,020 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 24,970 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up approximately 3.4% of Patriot Wealth Management Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its 4th biggest position. Patriot Wealth Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $27,093,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Trust Co. of Vermont lifted its position in shares of Apple by 1.3% during the 1st quarter. Trust Co. of Vermont now owns 162,379 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,244,000 after acquiring an additional 2,128 shares during the last quarter. Xact Kapitalforvaltning AB lifted its position in shares of Apple by 4.5% during the 1st quarter. Xact Kapitalforvaltning AB now owns 1,007,805 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $169,090,000 after acquiring an additional 43,480 shares during the last quarter. Moors & Cabot Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 2.0% during the 1st quarter. Moors & Cabot Inc. now owns 97,403 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $16,342,000 after acquiring an additional 1,909 shares during the last quarter. Wesbanco Bank Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 35.9% during the 1st quarter. Wesbanco Bank Inc. now owns 355,584 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $59,660,000 after acquiring an additional 93,852 shares during the last quarter. Finally, WINTON GROUP Ltd raised its stake in Apple by 85.2% during the 1st quarter. WINTON GROUP Ltd now owns 159,031 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $26,682,000 after purchasing an additional 73,143 shares during the period. 57.02% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. AAPL has been the topic of several recent analyst reports. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and set a $228.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 11th. Royal Bank of Canada reissued a “buy” rating and set a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 18th. Citigroup cut their target price on shares of Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, November 2nd. Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Thursday, December 6th. Finally, Morgan Stanley boosted their target price on shares of Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a research note on Thursday, November 8th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $191.66.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this hyperlink . 0.05% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.
AAPL stock traded up $0.08 during midday trading on Friday, reaching $166.52. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 32,642,411 shares, compared to its average volume of 34,981,904. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $142.00 and a 52 week high of $233.47. The stock has a market cap of $818.47 billion, a PE ratio of 13.98, a PEG ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.13. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a net margin of 22.72% and a return on equity of 51.09%. The firm had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. As a group, sell-side analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.39 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be paid a $0.73 dividend. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 8th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.75%. Apple’s payout ratio is presently 24.52%.
